# Bundled Premake

Version: **5.0.0-beta8**. Used by `Setup.bat` to generate VS 2026/v145 projects by default, or VS 2022/v143 projects with `Setup.bat vs2022`.

- [Official release](https://github.com/premake/premake-core/releases/tag/v5.0.0-beta8)
- [Windows archive](https://github.com/premake/premake-core/releases/download/v5.0.0-beta8/premake-5.0.0-beta8-windows.zip)
- Archive SHA-256: `e64ce2ed8778e0098f63674cca61fe33941b5f0c8d9a4afd651152bdea3758ab`
- `premake5.exe` SHA-256: `2301e3e23ff3074cb83a5ea6103d68c7ea81dad56b786807c84b0643cddea31b`

The archive was verified against the SHA-256 in GitHub's release asset metadata before extracting the executable. The release archive contains only the executable; `LICENSE.txt` is from the matching upstream source tag.
